crossRefs.note: He returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, “See now, I know…
But he said, “As Yahweh lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.
So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden…
You have profaned me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls who should not…
Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain.…

people.name: Simon
people.line: Sorcerer in Samaria who tried to buy the Holy Spirit's power.

translations.web: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
translations.bsb: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.
translations.kjv: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
translations.asv: Now when Simon saw that through the laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Spirit was given, he offered them money,
